title: Overnight Matcha Coconut Chia Parfait
hookLine: Antioxidant-rich ceremonial matcha & creamy coconut milk chia pudding layered with fresh berries.

items.name: Organic black or white chia seeds
Ceremonial matcha + 1 tbsp pure maple syrup

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {mc_chia} and {mc_mlk} and {mc_mat} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Whisk Matcha Milk & Chia Seeds
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {mc_mlk} and {mc_mat} frothy, stir in {mc_chia}, wait 5 mins and stir again to prevent clumps, then chill 2+ hours. Plate into 2 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.creatorSecret: Stirring a second time after 5 minutes guarantees an ultra-smooth, lump-free pudding.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {mc_mat} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as Overnight Matcha Coconut Chia Parfait coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 2 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 190 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
